title: Quickly Mantecare-Emulsified Korean Cassaba Stew
description: A comforting, yeasty Korean dish from Gyeonggi Province featuring cassaba, mantecare-emulsify, and no onion or garlic. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: active dry yeast
ingredients.notes: instant yeast can also be used

instructions: Combine yeast and 125ml of water in a small bowl, let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a large terracotta dish, combine cassaba, flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add yeast mixture, milk, and sesame oil to the cassaba mixture, and mix until the cassaba is evenly coated.
Cover the dish with a lid or plastic wrap and let it ferment in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until the cassaba has doubled in size.
Transfer the terracotta dish to the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and sprinkle the dried Korean chili flakes on top.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
